content.title: Iconic Chuck Norris Movies and TV Shows to Stream Now
content.text: Key PointsSeveral of Chuck Norris's most iconic films, including Lone Wolf McQuade and Missing in Action, are available to stream now across Prime Video, Tubi, and Pluto TV.Walker, Texas Ranger — Norris's most beloved work — ran for nine seasons from 1993 to 2001, with select seasons available free on Pluto TV and The Roku Channel, and the complete series on Prime Video.Lone Wolf McQuade (1983) is the best starting point for new fans — the Texas Ranger role Norris played in that film directly inspired the character he would go on to play for nine seasons on television. With the passing of Chuck Norris, fans are revisiting the films and television that made him a legend. Whether you’re a lifelong fan or discovering his work for the first time, here’s where to find his most iconic titles across the major streaming platforms right now. Chuck Norris Movies on Prime Video Amazon Prime Video has the deepest Chuck Norris library of any major streamer, with titles including The Delta Force (1986) — his biggest box office hit — as well as Missing in Action (1984), the film that turned him into a household name, and Lone Wolf McQuade (1983), the Texas Ranger prototype that directly inspired Walker, Texas Ranger. Chuck Norris Movies Free on Tubi and Pluto TV Several of Norris’s most iconic titles are available to stream for free. Lone Wolf McQuade is currently streaming on both Tubi and Pluto TV — a great starting point for anyone new to his work. The film follows Norris as Texas Ranger Jim “J.J.” McQuade, a role that laid the direct groundwork for his most beloved character. Pluto TV includes a lineup of 16 iconic Chuck Norris movies inluding titles like Good Guys Wear Black and An Eye for an Eye. Where to Stream ‘Walker, Texas Ranger’ Walker, Texas Ranger ran on CBS for nine seasons from 1993 to 2001 and remains Norris’s most enduring work. Select seasons are available to stream for free on both Pluto TV and The Roku Channel. For the complete nine-season run, Prime Video remains the best option for subscribers. Which Chuck Norris Movie to Watch First If you’re new to Chuck Norris, you’re in for a wild ride, extending across multiple eras. For his martial arts roots, start with Return of the Dragon (1972), in which he faces Bruce Lee in the Roman Colosseum in one of the most iconic fight sequences in cinema history. For his 1980s action peak, Missing in Action and Lone Wolf McQuade are the essential titles. For his television legacy, Walker, Texas Ranger is the definitive starting point. About the authorRachel Schneider is a Trending News Writer for Men’s Journal with several years of experience writing across digital media, with a background that spans service journalism, lifestyle content, and breaking news.Trending Stories
